Format conversion by the Grain project, 2026-10-02:
The original 512x512 RGB Hald images were repacked into 64x64x64 RGB lookup tables.
All 8-bit source samples and their ordering are preserved without resampling,
additional grading, or a color-space conversion. Android converts each channel
to float with byte / 255 and uses its existing trilinear LUT renderer.
The converted tables are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

Input/output are used as sRGB SDR, following the RawTherapee film-simulation
collection convention: https://rawpedia.rawtherapee.com/Film_Simulation
Visual results on actual Android preview/photo/video pipelines remain to be checked.

These are community creative approximations, not Kodak official LUTs or calibrated
reproductions. No grain or halation is included. The descriptive film-stock names
do not imply affiliation with or endorsement by Kodak. See upstream README.
